title: Late possession and then defects
turns: Flat in Tellapur, Hyderabad, project Lake View Heights by Vertex Builders, RERA registered. Promised possession was 31 December 2023 but they handed over only on 1 August 2025. I paid 72 lakh in total. Now the bathroom ceiling leaks and the plaster is cracking. I want delay interest and the defects fixed.
